stories.headline: US-Iran Ceasefire Frays as Hormuz Stays Blocked; Israel Agrees to Direct Lebanon Talks

key_facts.fact: In the first 24 hours of the ceasefire, just a single oil products tanker and five dry bulk carriers passed through the Strait of Hormuz, which normally carries 140 ships and a fifth of the world's oil daily.
key_facts.excerpt: just a single oil products tanker and five dry bulk carriers sailed through the strait, which typically carries a fifth of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas flows and 140 ships a day before the war

key_facts.fact: US-Iran talks are scheduled for Saturday April 11 in Islamabad, with Vice President JD Vance leading the US delegation opposite Iran's Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf.
key_facts.excerpt: authorities were preparing for the first round of US-Iran talks on Saturday aimed at settling the conflict that began with US and Israeli attacks on Iran on February 28

key_facts.fact: Israeli PM Netanyahu said he has given instructions to start direct peace negotiations with Lebanon, with talks expected in Washington next week, focused on disarming Hezbollah.
key_facts.excerpt: Following repeated requests from the Lebanese government to open peace negotiations with us, last night I instructed the Cabinet to begin direct negotiations with Lebanon

key_facts.fact: Iran's new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei vowed retribution on the 40th day of mourning for his father, killed in US-Israeli airstrikes: 'We will certainly not leave unpunished the criminal aggressors.'
key_facts.excerpt: We will certainly not leave unpunished the criminal aggressors who attacked our country. We will undoubtedly demand compensation for every single damage inflicted

key_facts.fact: Trump said Iran was doing a 'very poor job' of allowing oil through the strait, while Iran cited Israel's ongoing Lebanon strikes — which killed over 250 on April 8 — as justification for keeping Hormuz blocked.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran made clear that any ceasefire deal must include Lebanon. And Pakistan, which brokered this ceasefire, also said Lebanon was included in that two-week deal reached Tuesday night

key_facts.fact: Three diplomats confirmed China used its leverage as Iran's biggest oil buyer to urge Tehran back to the negotiating table, with Trump acknowledging China played a role in the ceasefire.
key_facts.excerpt: Three diplomats who were familiar with China's behind-the-scenes efforts also confirmed that Beijing, the biggest purchaser of Iranian oil, used its leverage to urge the Iranians back to the negotiating table

key_facts.fact: The UAE intercepted 17 ballistic missiles and 45 drone attacks since the ceasefire began, while Kuwait reported intense attacks on oil infrastructure and three power/water desalination facilities.
key_facts.excerpt: The UAE's Ministry of Defense reported that 17 ballistic missiles and 45 drone attacks had been intercepted since the ceasefire took place. Kuwaiti officials reported 'intense' attacks throughout Wednesday, targeting oil infrastructure and three power and water desalination facilities

stories.headline: Bessent and Powell Summon Wall Street CEOs to Warn About Anthropic Mythos Cyber Risks

key_facts.fact: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Fed Chair Jerome Powell summoned CEOs of systemically important banks to an urgent meeting at Treasury headquarters to discuss cyber risks from Anthropic's Mythos model.
key_facts.excerpt: Bessent and Powell assembled the group at Treasury's headquarters in Washington on Tuesday to make sure banks are aware of possible future risks raised by Anthropic's Mythos and potential similar models

key_facts.fact: Mythos can identify and exploit vulnerabilities in every major operating system and web browser when directed by a user, according to Anthropic's own disclosures.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic's Mythos is a more powerful system that the AI firm has said is capable of identifying and then exploiting vulnerabilities in every major operating system and web browser when directed by a user to do so

key_facts.fact: CEOs summoned include Citigroup's Jane Fraser, Morgan Stanley's Ted Pick, Bank of America's Brian Moynihan, Wells Fargo's Charlie Scharf, and Goldman Sachs's David Solomon.
key_facts.excerpt: Chief executive officers summoned to the meeting with the Fed and Treasury include Citigroup Inc.'s Jane Fraser, Morgan Stanley's Ted Pick, Bank of America Corp.'s Brian Moynihan, Wells Fargo & Co.'s Charlie Scharf, and Goldman Sachs Group

key_facts.fact: Anthropic limited Mythos release to about 40 major tech and finance firms under 'Project Glasswing,' including Amazon, Apple, and JPMorgan, to secure critical systems before broader availability.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic has limited the release of it to just a few major technology and finance firms at first. Those companies, which include Amazon.com Inc. and Apple Inc. as well as JPMorgan Chase & Co., are part of 'Project Glasswing'

key_facts.fact: Anthropic had been in discussions with US officials about Mythos's 'offensive and defensive cyber capabilities' prior to its release.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic has said that it has been in discussions prior to its recent release with US officials about Mythos and its 'offensive and defensive cyber capabilities'

stories.headline: NASA's Artemis 2 Crew Set for Pacific Splashdown Tonight After Historic Moon Flyby

key_facts.fact: The Artemis 2 crew — astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and CSA's Jeremy Hansen — is scheduled to splash down off the coast of San Diego at approximately 8:07 PM EDT on Friday, April 10.
key_facts.excerpt: NASA teams on the ground are completing final preparations for Orion's re-entry and splashdown around 8:07 p.m. (5:07 p.m. PDT) Friday, April 10, off the coast of San Diego

key_facts.fact: Artemis 2 is NASA's first crewed mission to the moon since Apollo 17 in 1972; the crew swung around the far side of the Moon on April 6 and exited the lunar sphere of influence on April 7.
key_facts.excerpt: Following a swing around the far side of the Moon on April 6, 2026, the crew exited the lunar sphere of influence on April 7, and are headed back to Earth for a splashdown in the Pacific Ocean on April 10

key_facts.fact: Orion will perform a 'lofted' reentry — dipping into the atmosphere, skipping up, then descending again — to reduce heat stress on the heat shield after unexpected char losses during the uncrewed Artemis 1 mission.
key_facts.excerpt: Orion will perform what's called a 'lofted' reentry, dipping down into the atmosphere briefly, before delving back down for its final descent — similar to a stone skipping once across a pond before sinking beneath the water

key_facts.fact: The service module will separate around 7:33 PM EDT, parachutes deploy at 8:04 PM, with USS John P. Murtha recovery operations within two hours of splashdown.
key_facts.excerpt: the service module will separate around 7:33 p.m., about 20 minutes before Orion reaches the upper... unfurl its three main parachutes around 6,000 feet at 8:04 p.m.

key_facts.fact: NASA Associate Administrator Amit Kshatriya said: 'To every engineer, every technician that's touched this machine tomorrow belongs to you. The crew has done their part. Now we have to do ours.'
key_facts.excerpt: To every engineer, every technician that's touched this machine tomorrow belongs to you... The crew has done their part. Now we have to do ours.

stories.headline: Eli Lilly's Foundayo, First Oral GLP-1 Weight-Loss Pill, Now Available in the US at $149/Month

key_facts.fact: Eli Lilly announced on April 9 that Foundayo (orforglipron), the only oral GLP-1 pill approved for weight loss, is now available in the US via LillyDirect, telehealth providers, and retail pharmacies.
key_facts.excerpt: Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE: LLY) ha anunciado hoy que Foundayo (orforglipron) ya está disponible para adultos con obesidad o con sobrepeso

key_facts.fact: Foundayo starts at $149/month for self-pay patients; commercially insured patients may pay as low as $25/month; Medicare Part D patients will pay $50/month starting July 1, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: The medication will start at $149 per month for self-pay patients at the lowest dosage level. Commercially insured patients who qualify for the Foundayo savings card may pay as little as $25 per month.

key_facts.fact: In the ATTAIN-1 trial, participants on the highest dose lost an average of 27.3 pounds (12.4%) vs. 2.2 pounds (0.9%) for placebo; the study enrolled 3,127 participants from 10 countries.
key_facts.excerpt: In clinical studies, participants taking the highest dose and remaining on therapy lost an average of 27.3 pounds, compared with 2.2 pounds among those receiving a placebo.

key_facts.fact: Foundayo is a once-daily pill with no food or water restrictions, a key differentiator from injectable GLP-1 treatments like Lilly's own Zepbound (tirzepatide). FDA approved it on April 1, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Foundayo es una pastilla que se toma una vez al día para la pérdida de peso y no tiene restricciones de alimentos ni agua

key_facts.fact: Orforglipron was originally discovered by Chugai Pharmaceutical and licensed to Lilly in 2018. The ATTAIN clinical program enrolled more than 4,500 participants across two global trials.
key_facts.excerpt: The ATTAIN clinical development program included more than 4,500 participants across two global registration trials.

sources.title: Foundayo (orforglipron), la nueva pastilla GLP-1 de Lilly, ahora está disponible en Estados Unidos

stories.headline: TSMC Q1 Revenue Surges 35% to $35.7B, Beating Estimates as AI Chip Demand Holds

key_facts.fact: TSMC reported January-March 2026 revenue of T$1.134 trillion ($35.71 billion), up 35% year-over-year from T$839.3 billion, beating the LSEG SmartEstimate of T$1.125 trillion from 20 analysts.
key_facts.excerpt: January-March revenue reached T$1.134 trillion ($35.71 billion) compared with T$839.3 billion in the same period a year earlier... The result topped an LSEG SmartEstimate of T$1.125 trillion drawn from 20 analysts

key_facts.fact: The result was in line with TSMC's own January guidance of $34.6 billion to $35.8 billion, signaling AI chip demand remained intact despite the Middle East war disrupting energy costs.
key_facts.excerpt: was in line with TSMC's January guidance of $34.6 billion to $35.8 billion given at its last earnings call... TSMC's latest record-smashing quarterly revenue comes as war in the Middle East is raising energy costs

key_facts.fact: Analysts raised their forecast for TSMC's April-June revenue by 2.3% over the last 30 days to a record T$1.2 trillion, betting on constrained capacity for advanced AI chip production.
key_facts.excerpt: Analysts nevertheless raised their forecast for TSMC's April-June revenue by 2.3 per cent over the last 30 days to a record T$1.2 trillion

key_facts.fact: TSMC's Taipei-listed shares have gained 29% year-to-date versus 22% for the benchmark index. The company will report full Q1 earnings on April 16.
key_facts.excerpt: Its Taipei-listed shares have gained 29 per cent this year versus a rise of 22 per cent in the benchmark share price index

key_facts.fact: TSMC raised its 2026 capex budget to $52–56 billion (up ~30% from $40.9B in 2025), primarily for 3nm and 2nm node expansion. Its 2nm capacity is already fully booked for 2026 by Apple and Nvidia.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC has aggressively raised its capital expenditure budget for 2026 to a range of $52 billion to $56 billion, a roughly 30% increase from the $40.9 billion spent the previous year

stories.headline: RISC-V Chip Designer SiFive Raises $400M at $3.65B Valuation in Final Round Before IPO

key_facts.fact: SiFive raised $400 million in an oversubscribed Series G led by Atreides Management, with participation from Nvidia, Apollo Global Management, Point72 Turion, and T. Rowe Price, valuing the company at $3.65 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: SiFive said on Thursday it has raised a $400 million round of funding from Atreides Management, Nvidia and others to enter the booming market for data-center central processor chips. The round brings SiFive's valuation to $3.65 billion

key_facts.fact: CEO Patrick Little told Reuters this is expected to be SiFive's last funding round before an IPO, though he did not specify timing.
key_facts.excerpt: CEO Patrick Little told Reuters he expects it to be the firm's last round of funding before filing for a public offering, though he did not say when SiFive plans to do so

key_facts.fact: SiFive sells customizable RISC-V processor IP (blueprints) to customers like Google; the open standard is gaining ground after Arm began competing directly with its own customers by launching its own chips last month.
key_facts.excerpt: SiFive does not sell chips but instead sells blueprints that customers such as Alphabet's Google can customize for their own internal chip designs. That intellectual property business was for decades dominated by Arm Holdings, but Arm last month unveiled its own chips

key_facts.fact: The funds will be used to develop data center CPU designs targeting the agentic AI workload opportunity, which Little called 'the highest brass ring in the data center.'
key_facts.excerpt: We've decided that we're going after the highest brass ring in the data center

key_facts.fact: SiFive has shipped more than 10 billion RISC-V cores across over 500 chip designs. Returning investors include Prosperity7 Ventures and Sutter Hill Ventures.
key_facts.excerpt: With a strong presence in over 500 chip designs and more than 10 billion cores shipped, SiFive continues to set industry benchmarks

sources.title: SiFive raises $400 million from Atreides, Nvidia for data-center chip technology

stories.headline: Jassy Shareholder Letter: AWS AI Revenue Hits $15B Run Rate, Amazon Chips Business at $20B+

key_facts.fact: Amazon disclosed for the first time that AWS AI services are generating an annualized revenue run rate of over $15 billion as of Q1 2026, roughly 10% of AWS's $142 billion total revenue run rate.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon's AI services at its cloud-computing unit are generating annualized revenue of more than $15 billion, CEO Andy Jassy said, the first time the company has reported numbers on a business it has backed with billions of dollars in investment

key_facts.fact: Amazon's custom chip business (Graviton, Trainium, Nitro) hit a $20 billion annualized revenue run rate, doubling from $10 billion disclosed at Q4. Jassy estimated it would be ~$50 billion if sold to third parties.
key_facts.excerpt: That business, which includes Graviton processors, Trainium AI chips and Nitro networking cards, now has an annualized revenue run-rate of over $20 billion, doubling from the $10 billion disclosed alongside fourth-quarter results

key_facts.fact: Jassy defended Amazon's projected $200 billion in 2026 capex: 'We're not investing approximately $200 billion in capex in 2026 on a hunch,' saying customer commitments cover a substantial portion.
key_facts.excerpt: We're not investing ... on a hunch... Of the AWS capex we expect to spend in 2026, much of which will be monetized in 2027-2028, we already have customer commitments for a substantial portion of it

key_facts.fact: Amazon's 2025 revenue grew 12% to $717 billion with $80 billion in operating income, but free cash flow fell from $38 billion to $11 billion due to $50.7 billion in additional capex.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon's total revenue grew to $717 billion in 2025, free cash flow fell from $38 billion to $11 billion due to a $50.7 billion increase in spending on property and equipment

key_facts.fact: Jassy said two large AWS customers asked to buy 'all' of Amazon's Graviton capacity for 2026, and signaled the company may sell custom chips to third parties in the future.
key_facts.excerpt: There's so much demand for our chips that it's quite possible we'll sell racks of them to third parties in the future

key_facts.fact: Amazon shares rose 4.5% following the letter. Jassy also pointed to a deal with OpenAI worth over $100 billion as evidence of demand backing the spending.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon shares rose 4.5%
